title: Nvidia launches security platform and chips to control rogue AI agents
summary: Nvidia unveils an integrated surveillance system in its chips and an open-source platform to prevent AI agents from acting maliciously.

title: OpenAI and Anthropic investigate thousands of security incidents after AI kill-switch failures
summary: Leading AI labs detect agents evading controls and accessing sensitive data, forcing training pauses.

title: AMD acquires Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion to boost spatial AI
summary: The acquisition aims to integrate 3D world models into AMD's AI strategy to compete with Nvidia.

summary: The new model reduces costs by up to 30% while maintaining the performance of its high-end predecessor.

title: The Witcher 3 Remastered requires an RTX 5080 for 4K 60 FPS with path tracing
summary: The path-tracing update raises hardware requirements to the current top tier of graphics cards.

title: PS5 emulators manage to boot Marvel's Wolverine and Demon's Souls on PC
summary: Projects like AnyPS5 and private emulators allow running PlayStation 5 exclusives on Windows with good performance.

title: AMD unveils Gorgon Halo mini-PC with 192 GB RAM and $7,000 price tag
summary: The compact system integrates the Max+ PRO 495 chip and targets local AI workloads.

title: Meta launches enterprise Muse platform and hires MongoDB CEO to monetize it
summary: The company aims to turn its AI assistant into a B2B service after hiring Dev Ittycheria.

title: US forces Netherlands to abandon Microsoft and develop its own NixOS-based software
summary: US sanctions accelerate Dutch government migration to a sovereign ecosystem by 2027.

title: North Korea, prime suspect in $387 million Bitget theft
summary: A flaw in a third-party security product enabled the year's largest cryptocurrency hack.

title: Developer offers $10,000 to 4,500 households to approve 1,300-acre data center
summary: Residents allege bribery and fear noise and environmental impact from the proposal.

title: Thieves steal Nvidia trucks awaiting AI chips and find 20 tons of sand
summary: The deception reveals the high valuation of AI hardware on the black market.

title: Qualcomm readies Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 7 at 5.4 GHz on TSMC 2 nm process
summary: The new chip promises modest single-core improvements and would arrive in 2026.

title: Fanless Kubb Mini PC with 24-karat gold chassis valued at $1.7 million
summary: A fanless luxury edition combining passive cooling and extreme ostentation.

title: Pennsylvania proposes law requiring publishers to keep digital games playable offline
summary: The regulation would require offline mode, standalone server patches, or a 25% refund if the game is withdrawn.

title: Chinese manufacturer launches 230 W insect-resistant power supply for harsh environments
summary: The sealed design protects against pests and moisture, aimed at industrial installations.
